title: CSCI 242 — Computer Science for Transfer Students
subject: Programming and Languages
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Students will articulate precise problem statements including input/output examples and invariants.
Students will select and justify appropriate data structures (lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs) for a given computational task.
Students will design and implement a solution using decomposition, abstraction, and testing to meet correctness criteria.
